fichas.title: Ventilation systems in animal housing
fichas.summary: Overview of convection and forced ventilation, including shaft, eaves-ridge, pressurised, extract and balanced-pressure systems. The page gives operating conditions and energy requirements, illustrates fan types and an earth-filter system, and describes sizing air openings using printed formulas and variables.
